case.question: What voltage range can I feed the bare module from?
case.expected_behavior: VBAT 3.1 V to 4.5 V, typical 3.8 V.

result.question: What voltage range can I feed the bare module from?
result.answer: The C16QS module power supply range is between 3.1V – 4.5V [HW-v5.3-p028-1]. The VBAT_BB pins (32, 33) and VBAT_RF pins (52, 53) have a minimum voltage of 3.1V, a typical voltage of 3.8V, and a maximum voltage of 4.5V [HW-v5.3-p027-2].

case.question: How many UART ports does the module have?

result.question: How many UART ports does the module have?
result.answer: The C16QS module provides three sets of UART interfaces [HW-v5.3-p033-2]. These include the UART0 serial port, which is used as the debug UART [HW-v5.3-p033-3], the UART1 serial port [HW-v5.3-p034-2], and the UART2 serial port, which is used to obtain GNSS NMEA data [HW-v5.3-p035-1].

result.question: Which pin do I pull low to switch the module on?
result.answer: The 15th pin of the C16QS module, labeled PWRKEY_N, is the power on pin. The module is powered on by pulling the POWER_KEY low for at least 500ms.

case.question: How much humidity can the module tolerate?

result.question: How much humidity can the module tolerate?
result.answer: The module has a humidity tolerance of RH5%~RH95% [HW-v5.3-p014-1]. Additionally, for storage in a vacuum sealed bag at temperatures greater than 40 degrees Celsius, the air humidity must be less than 90% [HW-v5.3-p070-1]. Once the vacuum sealed bag is opened, if the ambient temperature is lower than 30 degrees Celsius, the air humidity must be less than 60% for the factory to complete the patch within 72 hours [HW-v5.3-p070-1].

case.question: How do I put the EVK into flight mode?

result.question: How do I put the EVK into flight mode?
result.answer: To put the C16QS EVK into flight mode, you can use Jumper 9 (JMP 9), which is used to enable Flight mode (W_Disable) [EVK-v1.1-p013-1]. Additionally, the module hardware provides a FLIGHT_MODE pin used to put the module into Flight mode and disable RF transmission [HW-v5.3-p051-1]. This is also identified as pin 18, labeled W_DISABLE#, in the module hardware manual [HW-v5.3-p051-2]. In Flight Mode, the module closes the RF circuit and is unable to interact with the network [HW-v5.3-p016-1].
